title: The Dragon's Tithe
text: A dragon's herald stops the road, a man with a burned face and a brass horn. The dragon must be paid, he says. One House among you will pay the tithe, and the dragon will choose which. He does not say how the dragon chooses.

options.label: Let the dragon choose who pays, and accept whatever it decides.

outcomes.text: It chooses. Nobody sees how. The House pays in gold, and the herald blows his horn, and the sky is quiet.

options.label: Refuse the tithe. No dragon taxes the Pact.

outcomes.text: The herald whistles, and the sky darkens, and it keeps darkening.

options.label: The bravest offers a challenge instead of gold, and dares the dragon to accept.

outcomes.text: The herald is amused, and lets you pass, and laughs about it for a long time.
The herald is not amused. He raises his horn, and fire answers it.
